description: This Java source file defines the CubeRenderer class which implements the GLSurfaceView.Renderer interface for rendering two tumbling 3D cubes using OpenGL ES in an Android application.

classes.name: CubeRenderer
classes.description: A renderer class that draws two tumbling cubes using OpenGL ES in an Android environment.

methods.name: CubeRenderer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the renderer with a background translucency setting and creating a Cube instance.

methods.description: Render method called for each frame, clearing buffers, setting up camera transformations, drawing cubes, and updating rotation angle.
